name: nom-quocngu-character-crops
title: Chu-Nom character crops aligned to Quoc-Ngu syllables
description: Per-character woodblock chu-Nom crops cross-labeled with SinoNom character + Unicode + Quoc-Ngu syllable, from a parallel Nom-QuocNgu corpus (Sach Cac Thanh Truyen 2/4/11).

fields.name: image
fields.description: Relative path to the crop PNG (renamed from 'image' for the HF imagefolder convention). Empty for REVIEW rows that have no crop.

fields.name: book
fields.description: Source book id (SachThanhTruyen 2/4/11).

fields.name: page
fields.description: Source page id (page_XXXX).

fields.name: column
fields.description: Column index on the page (1-9, right-to-left).

fields.name: ocr_char
fields.description: Raw SinoNom character from the HCMUS OCR (may be a misread).

fields.name: syllable
fields.description: Quốc-Ngữ syllable from VietOCR (the reading).

fields.name: label
fields.description: Confirmed SinoNom character (target). Empty when char-level is not confirmed (label_level=syllable).

fields.name: unicode
fields.description: Unicode code point of `label`, e.g. U+56FA.

fields.name: label_level
fields.description: Supervision level: 'char' (label is the character), 'syllable' (only the syllable is trusted), or '' (REVIEW).

fields.name: tier
fields.description: Trust tier: GOLD | SILVER | SYLLABLE | REVIEW.

fields.name: rule
fields.description: Decision rule that produced the label (e.g. s1_inter_s2_direct, s1_inter_s2_similar, s2_inter_s3_corrected, nghia_consensus).

fields.name: s3_cosine
fields.description: Visual-match cosine (trained Nôm embedder) for SILVER rows; empty otherwise.

fields.name: ink_pct
fields.description: Fraction of dark (ink) pixels in the crop (quality signal).

fields.name: crop_w
fields.description: Crop width in pixels.

fields.name: crop_h
fields.description: Crop height in pixels.

fields.name: image_md5
fields.description: 12-hex MD5 of the crop file (dedup/provenance).

fields.name: seg_flag
fields.description: Segmentation flag: 'ok' or 'tall' (possible merged/tall glyph).

fields.name: split
fields.description: Dataset split: train | val | test (leakage-safe, grouped by book/page/column).

fields.name: split_group
fields.description: Group key (book|page|column) guaranteeing a physical column never spans two splits.

fields.name: bbox
fields.description: Character bounding box on the full page, JSON [x1,y1,x2,y2] (xyxy).
